help.noController: No controller connected – pick yours to see its buttons.
help.c.overlay.title: Overlay on / off
help.c.overlay.desc: Opens FC-Tracker on top of the game: your Gallery with points, grades and what to do next. Hold again to close it.
help.c.missing.title: Buy next on / off
help.c.missing.desc: A slim list at the edge of the screen with the cards that add the most points to the set you are in. It never takes focus from the game.
help.c.category.title: Change category
help.c.category.desc: Steps through Leagues, Clubs, Rarities and the other Gallery categories. In Objectives L1/R1 switch the squad tabs (1. Rivals, 2. Ghoul Fest …) and left/right where to play.
help.c.move.title: Move
help.c.move.desc: Moves between the sets in the list – and between the cards once a set is open.
help.c.open.title: Open a set
help.c.open.desc: Opens the highlighted set, so you can move through its cards.
help.c.info.title: Card info
help.c.info.desc: Shows the card's version and first-owner status right next to the card.
help.c.back.title: Back / close
help.c.back.desc: Steps back one level. From the list it closes the overlay.
help.c.scroll.title: Scroll
help.c.scroll.desc: Scrolls through a long set. A small push scrolls slowly, a full push fast.
help.matchNote: In a match FC-Tracker steps aside – these buttons only do what the game does there.
overlay.recordingHint: A screen recording is running: while you just look, the game keeps the focus so the recording keeps the game. Your first controller press here also reaches the game, then the controller drives the overlay.
support.hint: FC-Tracker is free and made by one person – support it on Ko-fi

account.title: Sign in or create an account
account.pitch: Sign in to keep your data on all your devices and to use the trackers under your name. The Gallery tracker stays free without an account.
account.emailText: We send you a 6-digit code – no password. New here? The code creates your account.
account.codeSent: Code sent to {{email}} – it works for 10 minutes.
account.usernameText: 3–16 letters or digits. Shown on the trackers.
account.pickUsername: Pick a username – it's what others see.
account.eaNameText: Optional. Typed by you – never checked against EA.
account.syncText: Your Gallery data, Web App data, Champions matches and settings follow your account – and stay on this device too.
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.signInText: Everything FC-Tracker keeps for you – your Gallery, Champions weekends and objective squads – on any device. Sign in or create an account with your e-mail.

dash.championsEmpty: No Champions weekends tracked yet – switch the Champions tracker on in the app.
dash.objectivesSync: Your objectives come with a Web App sync (app or extension).

profile.pictureText: Shown next to your name on the trackers and the dashboard.
squads.savedEmpty: Save a squad to build it later – it's kept on your account too.
error.avatar_invalid: That picture can't be used – choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
account.conflict.title: Which data do you want to keep?
account.conflict.text: This device and your account both changed since they last matched. Nothing is chosen for you.
account.conflict.pending: Waiting for your choice – some data differs from your account.
account.yourDataText: Download everything we store about you, or delete the account and all its data at once.
account.deleteConfirm: This deletes the account and its synced data for good. This PC keeps its own data.
error.email_invalid: That doesn't look like an e-mail address.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries – wait a minute and try again.
error.mail_failed: The e-mail couldn't be sent – try again in a moment.
error.code_invalid: That code is wrong – check the e-mail and try again.
error.code_expired: The code has expired – send a new one.
error.signed_out: You were signed out – sign in again.
error.username_invalid: Use 3–16 letters, digits, spaces or _ . - (no links).
error.username_taken: That username is taken – pick another.
error.ea_name_invalid: Use 3–16 letters, digits, spaces or _ . - for the EA name.
error.sync_conflict: Another device synced at the same time – trying again shortly.
error.sync_other_account: The account's data is from another EA account (PC vs console) – not merged.
error.sync_bad_data: The synced data couldn't be read – this PC keeps its own.
error.too_large: The data is too large to sync.
error.offline: No connection to fc-tracker.com – tries again by itself.
error.server: The FC-Tracker server had a problem – try again in a moment.
error.bad_request: That request wasn't understood – update FC-Tracker and try again.
speed.lead: How fast FC-Tracker notices what happens in the menus. Faster costs more CPU. In a match only the scoreboard is looked at.
speed.autoHint: Auto uses {{preset}} on this PC (one step lighter on battery). Changing a value below switches to Custom.
speed.continuousText: Watches the game window all the time in the menus, scaled down on the graphics card. Off: the screen is copied on every look.
speed.watchText: How often the screen is checked for a change. The game shows a new picture every 7–17 ms, so below 16 ms gives nothing.
speed.sameText: One delay for still screens, moving screens and the transfer market.
speed.allText: Read once unchanged this long – and every time it passes while a screen keeps moving.
speed.stillText: Menus and set pages: read once unchanged this long. 0 = right away.
speed.animatedText: Packs, New Items, 3D backgrounds: read after this long, and again every time it passes while it moves.
speed.marketText: Search results, Bidding Options and purchases: read after this long.
speed.cost: ≈ {{looks}} looks per second. A read takes ≈ 0.3 s, so reads never come closer than that.
speed.match: In a match only the scoreboard is looked at (the clock for match reminders), as often as "In a match" says.

web.intro.title: Your Gallery, read from your screen
web.intro.step1: Share FC 27 – your screen, an Xbox Cloud tab or a capture card.
web.intro.step2: Open a Gallery set. FC-Tracker reads it and works out your best selection and the cards to buy next.
web.intro.step3: Add the Chrome extension to sync your whole club – or open Swap Player to show your cards for a set.
web.intro.private: Your game never leaves your browser – what FC-Tracker learns stays here. Sign in only if you want it on your account too (encrypted), to use it on every device. Anonymous usage counts and prices seen are sent.
web.console: On PlayStation or Xbox? Use a capture card or Xbox Cloud. On PC the app does all of this live on top of the game.

web.resetConfirm: Forget everything this browser has read?
web.unofficial: Unofficial fan project – not affiliated with EA.

web.sync.running: Syncing your club in the Web App…
settings.usageText: Counts that FC-Tracker runs (for the online count) and how far setup got, and shares EA's market averages you see with other users on your market – never your club, players or EA account. A random number keeps one PC from counting twice.
online.hint: FC-Tracker apps and browser tabs in use right now
missing.priceTitle: EA market average on your market · {{age}}
missing.priceNote: ≈ coins = EA's own market average – yours, or another FC-Tracker user's on the same market.
value.title: What each grade costs
value.reachedNote: Grade {{grade}} is already yours with the cards you have.
value.noBuys: No buys needed – just place the right cards and regrade.
value.howTo: Buy the dearest first, put it in the set, sell it again, then the next – a card counts after it is sold. You lose only EA's 5 % tax.
value.overNote: More than your {{coins}} coins – nothing above your balance is suggested.
value.unpricedNote: {{count}} cards that could do it have no price yet. Prices come from EA's market average as FC-Tracker users see it – it fills up by itself.
value.impossibleNote: Not reachable without first owner cards (bought cards are never first owner).
value.rowNothing: Nothing to gain within your coins
value.calculating: Calculating the best value of every set…
value.empty: No sets yet – sync your club or open a Gallery set in-game.
value.plannerSub: The most tokens for the least tax, from the cards you have – never more than your coins.
value.planEmpty: Nothing to buy within these coins.
value.planEmptyPrices: Not enough prices yet. Prices come from EA's market average as FC-Tracker users see it – check back after a sync.
missing.overBudget: {{count}} cards above your {{coins}} coins left out
missing.nextGrade: Best value next: grade {{grade}} · +{{tokens}} tokens · {{tax}} tax · {{buys}} buys
value.how1: Start with the dearest card on the list. The most you ever need at once is "Coins needed".
value.how2: Open the set in the Gallery, Swap Player → put the card in, Confirm Changes, then Regrade. The tokens are yours.
value.how3: List it on the market. A card keeps counting in the Gallery after it's sold – you only lose EA's 5 % tax.
value.neededHint: the most you need at once
value.setsHint: sets that go up a grade
value.stepCards: Buy these {{count}}, put them in {{set}} and Regrade to {{grade}} – then sell them again.
value.stepNoBuy: No buys: put the right cards you have in {{set}} and Regrade to {{grade}}.
value.pricesBody: {{sets}} sets can't be planned yet – {{cards}} of their cards have no price.
value.pricesWhy: Why: EA only sends a card's price when someone has it in their club or searches it on the market. FC-Tracker users share these prices automatically (only the card, its price and when), so this list fills up by itself with every sync.
value.pricesHelp: Want a set sooner? Search one of its players on the Web App's transfer market – its price joins the list for everyone.
value.tooDear: {{count}} grades cost more than your coins and are left out.
value.gradeNeeds: Grade {{grade}} needs a score of {{score}} and gives {{tokens}} tokens.
value.slotsLeft: {{count}} empty slots – a set gets a grade once every slot is filled
value.excludeTitle: Leave this card out – the next best one takes its place
value.fewerSets: Only {{count}} of {{asked}}: no other set gives tokens within your coins with the prices known today.
value.goalAllHint: Every set that gives tokens within your coins, best value first.
value.goalSetsHint: {{count}} sets up a grade, best value first – topped up with the cheapest grades when fewer give tokens.
value.goalTokensHint: Stop once you reach this many tokens.
value.autoUpdate: The plan follows your club: a card you bought and placed leaves the list after the next sync.
value.zeroTokens: Completes the set at grade {{grade}} – no tokens, but the cheapest set left within your coins.
value.topGrade: Highest within your coins: {{grade}} · needs ≈{{coins}} at once · {{tokens}} tokens in total
value.tickTitle: Tick it off when it's bought, placed and sold again
champs.news.title: Champions tracker
champs.news.text: Your Weekend League, tracked by itself – read from the game, nothing to press. It's a beta: switch it on and help us make it spot on.
champs.news.how: In a Champions match it looks at the scoreboard once a second. Switch it off any time – even mid-match – in Settings → Champions tracker.
champs.news.onText: Play a Champions match – it shows up in the overlay's Champions tab.
champs.webOnly: Champions tracking runs in the FC-Tracker app for Windows: it reads your matches from the game window.
champs.unconfirmed: Waiting for the hub to count it
champs.historyOpen: See every match of this weekend
champs.corrected: Final record as you reported it – games the tracker didn't read show the result only.
champs.privacy: Beta. Read from the game window only. Opponents' names stay on this PC.
settings.championsText: Reads your Champions matches: the hub, the scoreboard once a second and the result card after full time. Only the game window, only in Champions matches. Opponents' names stay on this PC.
speed.inMatchText: In a match: one small look at the scoreboard this often – the clock for match reminders and the Champions tracker (there at least every 3 s). After a Champions full time the result card is read at once.
champs.board.title: Weekly leaderboard
champs.board.waiting: Taking part as {{name}} – your weekend shows up after the next counted match.
champs.board.join: Show your weekend on the weekly leaderboard: Settings → Champions leaderboard.
settings.championsBoardText: Shows your weekend under the name you pick on fc-tracker.com: record, rank, and each match's result, score and goal minutes. Nothing else is sent – never your opponents or your gamertag.
missing.topReached: Top grade reached – a bought card would add points but no tokens, so nothing is worth buying here.
missing.nonePriced: No card with a known price within your coins yet – the most valuable ones are below.
missing.noValue: No buy within your coins adds points to this set.
missing.shopSub: +{{tokens}} tokens · {{players}} players · {{sets}} sets · {{coins}} needed at once
missing.shopNote: The Planner's plan with its coins and goal, dearest first: buy, put it in, Regrade, sell – then the next. A card leaves the list once the next sync shows it collected.
missing.shopWhere: Next to the game too: from the Planner, double-tap View (Create) – the side panel opens on this list.
missing.forCoinsSub: known price within {{coins}} · most points per 1K tax
missing.forCoinsSubNoBalance: known price · most points per 1K tax
missing.valuableSub: every card that adds points · most first
missing.unpricedIn: {{count}} cards that add points have no price seen yet – prices fill in as FC-Tracker users see them on the market.
